fusions.name: Thunder In
fusions.desc: Gallops up to 8 tiles to the target and rears behind your shield, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Run Them Down
fusions.desc: Rides down a target at or below 30% health with your shield, dealing 24 damage and consuming every affliction on it for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Lead the Charge
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Gathered Speed
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher.
